selection: First skill-needle task in dataset order, fixed before outcomes and identical in all four planned cells.
metadataSource: Scalar/counter-only projection of synthetic session metadata; no transcripts, raw databases, arguments, outputs or host paths retained.
notes: Both recorded GLM sessions reached their 1200-second deadline and are invalid, not quality failures. Their historical rows omit timeoutMs; the configured deadline is retained here rather than backfilled into the rows.
DeepSeek skills-all was interrupted after a persistent free usage cap. Zero recorded step finishes do not establish zero provider usage; no final row was reconstructed. DeepSeek all never started.
Compaction summaries are maxima across retained cumulative snapshots, not sums or guaranteed final session totals.
Startup and completed-step durations do not partition lifecycle wall time; the difference is unattributed time, not a measurement of MCP discovery.
The maximum observed overlap across this diagnostic and the pilot was three sessions. This does not establish safety at concurrency three or four.
No numeric HTTP 429, quota amount or reset time was established. The shared quota evidence records the controlled usage-cap marker, API/retry error classes and three internal attempts.
All provider calls stopped. No full study was launched.

historicalLibrary.selection: Ambient configured loadout library; not an explicit --library argument.
historicalLibrary.limitation: Counts were retained in controlled runner logs. Per-skill origins, source revisions, exact accepted names and original content were not captured at run time; the intended public corpus cannot be verified retrospectively.

historicalIsolation.network: Shared host network, including unrelated loopback listeners. New runs require pasta isolation.
historicalIsolation.nodeChecks: Legacy exit-code grading could accept an early module exit before assertions. New runs require expected test-case completion evidence.
historicalIsolation.resume: Use a fresh output directory with the new harness; legacy protocol and unknown library fingerprints cannot be resumed as equivalent.

metadataSamplingMethod.database: Active owned session home: data/opencode/*.db, opened SQLite mode=ro; newest mtime if initialization left more than one database.
metadataSamplingMethod.sessionIdentification: Private active-root marker selected the diagnostic runner root. Model/arm index was the current number of finalized diagnostic rows; paths were not persisted.
metadataSamplingMethod.cadence: Initial manual samples, then a loop with a 45-second delay, plus final manual samples; snapshots are not guaranteed final.
metadataSamplingMethod.countSql: select json_extract(data,'$.type'),count(*) from part group by 1
metadataSamplingMethod.tokenSql: select json_extract(data,'$.tokens') from part where json_extract(data,'$.type')='step-finish'
metadataSamplingMethod.projection: stepStarts=step-start count; stepFinishes=step-finish count; compactions=compaction count. Per-request prompt=input+cache.read+cache.write; retain only promptTokensMin/Max, UTC sampledAt, orderIndex, taskId, model and arm.
metadataSamplingMethod.aggregation: Group snapshots by model and arm; take maximum cumulative compactions, never sum snapshots. No transcripts or raw SQLite files retained.

quotaEvidenceMethod.identification: Match OpenCode processes by ancestry to the owned benchmark runner, its cwd and requested output directory. Match the namespace home inode/device to the owned session home.
quotaEvidenceMethod.input: Read each owned session data/opencode/log/*.log in memory, taking only its final 1000000 characters. No log text persisted.
quotaEvidenceMethod.counterSql: select json_extract(data,'$.type'),count(*) from part group by 1
quotaEvidenceMethod.projection: Persist only marker booleans, recognized constant error classes, integer internal retry counts and step/compaction counts, with UTC observation time. No HTTP status or reset time was inferred.
quotaEvidenceMethod.stop: After validating the usage marker for the owned sessions, freeze both schedulers, terminate them, and verify sandbox descendants exited before cleanup. Interrupted rows were not reconstructed.
